sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body dark brown, head slightly darker; ventral surface pale yellowish brown, darker at the sides; mouthparts, maxillary palps and legs slightly darker than the venter, otherwise concolorous with it; sides of abdomen and intersegmental membranes white. Head flat, without a fontanelle, sometimes with a rounded, slightly raised scar; length from the mandibular tip to the occiput equal to the distance between the outer margins of the compound eyes; head produced anteriorly into a triangle. Clypeus small, paler than the frons, slightly inflated, with a dark median longitudinal line; a punctiform depression anteromedial to the ocellus. Labrum ligulate, short. Compound eyes very small, not distinctly projecting. Ocelli subcircular, separated from the compound eye by their diameter or more. Antennae 19-segmented; basal segment largest, cylindrical, as is the second; third segment shortest; remaining segments slightly larger and more rounded. Pronotum about one-quarter narrower than the head width including eyes, semicircular; anterior margin slightly upturned, weakly concave at the middle; sides distinctly deflexed; posterior margin weakly concave. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum weakly concave at the middle, more markedly so in the latter, sides broadly rounded. Fore wing media parallel and close to the submedia, only slightly diverging outwards; media branching in the last third and reaching the wing margin in about six veins; hind wing media arising from the subcosta near the wing scales. Abdominal appendages very small, nodular. Legs reaching about the abdominal apex; femur and tibia about 2.2 and 2.4 mm long respectively. Body, especially the pronotum, densely covered with fine hairs. Wing span 43–44 mm; body length with wings 23 mm; wing length 21 mm, width 5.5 mm; body length with head 12 mm.
